name: Sprinto
description: Sprinto is a governance, risk, and compliance automation platform for workflow checks, controls, evidence, staff, devices, risks, policies, audits, trust centers, and continuous monitoring.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned Developer API key for a US-resident Sprinto account. Selected agents can list only bounded workflow-check IDs and titles through one hard-coded GraphQL query. Relay blocks arbitrary GraphQL, introspection, evidence, staff, controls, risks, non-US origins, and every mutation.

credentialRequirements.name: SPRINTO_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Sprinto Developer API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Admin-issued key for a US-resident Sprinto account. Sprinto currently gives keys full graph access; Relay exposes only one bounded read query.

capabilities.label: Read workflow-check directory
capabilities.description: List a bounded, minimized directory of implemented compliance-check titles.

allowed.label: List workflow checks
allowed.description: List up to 20 minimized workflow-check IDs and titles from a US-resident Sprinto account.

blocked.label: Access compliance records or change Sprinto
blocked.description: Arbitrary GraphQL, introspection, evidence, staff, controls, risks, policies, audits, trust data, files, non-US origins, and every mutation are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One bounded workflow-check directory read runs directly; arbitrary GraphQL, sensitive records, non-US origins, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway pins the US GraphQL origin and exposes one hard-coded bounded workflow-check query.
Railway pins the US GraphQL origin and exposes one hard-coded bounded workflow-check query.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer has supplied a US-resident Sprinto Developer API key and representative workflow checks for non-production acceptance. Sprinto's beta API currently gives every key complete access to the available GraphQL schema rather than a read-only scope.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Sprinto administrator for a US-resident account creates a dedicated API key, stores it through Relay's encrypted credential flow, and validates only the bounded workflow-check query, GraphQL and mutation denial, key disable/rotation, disconnect, 10-request-per-minute handling, and post-disconnect denial in non-production. EU and India remain unsupported until Sprinto documents callable GraphQL endpoints rather than explorer URLs.

evidence.supports: Sprinto documents the fixed US GraphQL endpoint, api-key request header, admin-generated keys, complete available-graph authority, and a simple JSON POST contract.
Sprinto documents GraphQL query and mutation roots, workflowChecksPaginated, first and after arguments, and mutation support that Relay excludes.
Sprinto documents Relay-style cursor pagination and a workflow-check response containing edge cursors and node titles.

Sprinto documents beta status, no uptime or backward-compatibility guarantee, admin API-key authentication, a 10-request-per-minute per-IP and per-key limit, and regional URLs; only the US URL is documented as a GraphQL endpoint.

Sprinto describes pulling risks, controls, and evidence, pushing findings and signals, arbitrary GraphQL shaping, cursor pagination, and admin-issued controlled API keys, supporting Relay's narrow runtime boundary.
